compiled_state.title: UPDATE tests: REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md and sprint SKILL.md must not reference score-based pass/fail
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md does not reference REVIEW_RESULT, MIN_SCORE, or numeric score thresholds for pass/fail determination
- DD4: sprint SKILL.md uses severity-based language instead of 'all scores >= 4' and 'REVIEW_RESULT: passed'

## What to add
Add structural contract tests (design-contract exceptions per behavioral-testing-standard.md Rule 5 — prompt text IS the behavioral contract) asserting:

### In tests/workflows/test-review-workflow-dispatch-pattern.sh (or create a new test file tests/workflows/test-review-workflow-severity-schema.sh):

test_review_workflow_no_min_score_passfail_criterion:
  Given: plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md
  When: grep for 'MIN_SCORE' in pass/fail sections
  Then: NOT present — severity-based language used instead
  RED: fails until T3 updates REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md

test_review_workflow_no_review_result_passcriterion:
  Given: REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md
  When: grep for 'all scores >= 4' (old pass criterion)
  Then: NOT present
  RED: fails until T3

test_sprint_skill_no_all_scores_criterion:
  Given: plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md
  When: grep for 'all scores >= 4'
  Then: NOT present
  RED: fails until T3

Note: REVIEW_RESULT: passed CONTEXT ANCHOR in sprint SKILL.md may be tricky — check if it's in the context anchor block. The CONTEXT ANCHOR lines reference REVIEW_RESULT as part of error-prevention guidance ('When REVIEW_RESULT: passed is received... this is NOT a session completion signal'). These are control-flow guards, not pass/fail criteria. They should stay or be updated to reference severity-based completion signals.

## .test-index RED markers required
If test file is new (tests/workflows/test-review-workflow-severity-schema.sh):
  Add to .test-index: plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md:tests/workflows/test-review-workflow-severity-schema.sh

If adding to existing test file, add RED markers:
  tests/workflows/<file>.sh [test_review_workflow_no_min_score_passfail_criterion]
  tests/workflows/<file>.sh [test_review_workflow_no_review_result_passcriterion]

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] test_review_workflow_no_min_score_passfail_criterion exists
  Verify: grep -rq 'test_review_workflow_no_min_score_passfail_criterion' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/
- [ ] test_sprint_skill_no_all_scores_criterion exists
  Verify: grep -rq 'test_sprint_skill_no_all_scores_criterion' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/
- [ ] .test-index has RED markers for new tests
  Verify: grep -q 'test_review_workflow_no_min_score_passfail_criterion' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
